claims: NASA’s Artemis II mission successfully launched on April 1, 2026
NASA’s Artemis II mission launched at 6:35 p.m. EDT
NASA’s Artemis II mission launched from Kennedy Space Center, Florida
The SLS rocket carried four astronauts into orbit
NASA’s Artemis II mission is the first crewed mission to the moon in over 50 years
NASA’s Artemis II mission is aimed at a 10-day journey around the lunar surface
Artemis II is the first crewed moon flyby since Apollo
The crew of Artemis II is Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen
The crew of Artemis II is in high Earth orbit following a successful liftoff
The goal of Artemis II is a 10-day mission to orbit the moon and return to Earth
There were minor reports of issues with the toilet system onboard Artemis II
The Artemis II mission is proceeding
